categories.main_business_segments: Eastern Media International Corporation operates primarily in three business segments: warehousing, media, and trading. The warehousing segment focuses on bulk grain storage and handling at port silos. The media segment includes digital news, audiovisual content production, advertising, and polling services under ETtoday and related brands. The trading segment centers on pet products and services through ET Pet Co., Ltd., including retail stores and e-commerce.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The warehousing business utilizes automated grain unloading machines and silo operations with AI-driven initiatives to enhance efficiency. The media business leverages patented technologies for mobile apps, content e-commerce, online audio and video streaming, and integrates AI tools for content creation such as AI news summaries and AI voice broadcasts. The trading business employs AI-powered data analytics for personalized pet health management and integrates online and offline sales channels.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The warehousing segment serves domestic feed mills, salad oil mills, flour mills, and import traders primarily in central and southern Taiwan. The media segment targets Taiwanese digital news consumers, advertisers, and social media users, with an expanding presence in mainland China and overseas Chinese communities. The trading segment serves pet owners across Taiwan through physical stores and e-commerce, focusing on pet food, supplies, grooming, and veterinary services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan, with warehousing facilities at Taichung and Kaohsiung ports. The media business has a strong presence in Taiwan and extends to mainland China, Hong Kong, Southeast Asia, North America, and other overseas Chinese markets. The trading business is focused on Taiwan with plans for expansion. The company also has affiliated companies and investments in Panama, Hong Kong, Shanghai, and other locations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Eastern Media International operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments. In warehousing, it functions as a midstream service provider handling grain unloading, storage, and transfer. In media, it acts as a content creator and distributor downstream to consumers and advertisers. In trading, it operates downstream retail and e-commerce channels for pet products and services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes AI integration across business units to improve operational efficiency and content innovation. In warehousing, it focuses on automation and smart technologies for labor savings and safety. Media R&D centers on AI-enhanced audiovisual content, big data precision marketing, and new media business models like podcasts and short videos. The trading segment prioritizes AI-driven personalized pet health management, multi-channel sales, proprietary product development, and expansion of pet medical services.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through silo operation fees in the warehousing business, digital and out-of-home advertising sales, content marketing, and polling services in the media business. The trading business earns revenue from pet product sales, grooming, veterinary services, and e-commerce. The company also gains income from endorsements, guarantees, and investments in affiliated companies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In warehousing, the company holds a dominant market share in Taiwan's bulk grain silo operations with advanced automation and extensive port facilities. In media, ETtoday leads Taiwan’s digital news market in traffic and trust, competing with platforms like UDN, LINE TODAY, and emerging digital media. In pet retail, ET Pet is among the top three professional pet chain operators in Taiwan, competing with Pet parks and Petsmall, leveraging brand awareness and multi-channel integration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated operating income of approximately NTD 5.75 billion in 2024, with a net profit of NTD 305 million, marking a significant turnaround from losses in prior years. Total assets increased by about 10.87% to NTD 19.48 billion, and equity rose by 22.78% to NTD 5.18 billion. The company is investing heavily in capital expenditures, including a NTD 13 billion headquarters project, and continues to expand its media and trading businesses. The financial outlook anticipates stable growth supported by diversified operations and strategic investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Eastern Media International differentiates itself through its integrated business model combining warehousing, media, and trading. Its warehousing segment offers high-efficiency, automated bulk grain handling with strong market share and strategic port locations. The media segment provides trusted, high-quality digital news and innovative audiovisual content with AI-driven personalization and a comprehensive advertising ecosystem. The trading segment offers a unique pet ecosystem with extensive physical stores, professional veterinary partnerships, proprietary products, and AI-powered health management, creating a comprehensive service experience for pet owners.
